notes.title: Magic Toilet Brush Mini DLC Released! :)
notes.content:

Here it is:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946310/VR_Flush__Magic_Toilet_Brush_VR/]Magic Toilet Brush DLC (VR)[/url]

This is just something you can get if you liked VR Flush and want to support us.
Its designed vor VR, so please only by this if you have VR;)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"This royal artifact will strike fear into the hearts of you enemies and legitimate your claim to the throne!
According to legend, it rules even over gravity."
And the best part: If you buy now, you get a second one for free!! x)

Magic Toilet Brush[TM]...
[list]
[*]    ...is just like an ordinary toilet brush... but MAGIC!

[*]    ...charges other items with lightning and makes them float like in zero gravity!

[*]    ...is the perfect weapon for every aspiring Jedi! (Especially for those who just can't afford a lightsaber right now...)

[*]    ...plays magical music...But only for those who know how to listen...

[*]    ...is rumored to have hidden fireworks thrusters! Wait... If that's thrue, does that mean it can fly?!! There has got to be a way to activate them!

[*]    ...has an ultimate ability: Supports us and shows us, that you like the game!
[/list]

notes.title: Now With Full Motion Controller Support (Hands)! =)
notes.content:
Your hands have finally arrived (in VR Flush) :)
Many of you have been wanting this update (including me) and now its here!

Let me know if you encounter any bugs or if you feel like something could be better!

Have fun!:)

Felix

[b]Ninja Update:[/b]
As it turns out, scoring hoops is harder using motion controllers than it was before this update, when you did everything with your head and a crosshair.

[u]So I increased the size of the basketball hoop quit a bit[/u] - I don't want people to get frustrated. (Especially since this game is supposed to be perfect for VR newbies)

If you think its too easy now - just throw those balls without using the throw button. There - you got your challange back!;)

notes.title: Hands - update will be released at the end of juli. Sorry for the delay!
notes.content:
Its almost done, but unfortunately I can't work on it during the next 7 days.
For those of you who have been asking .. Sorry for the delay guys!

Felix

notes.title: Achievements added! Performance Improved:)
notes.content:
Just a small patch. 
I added 5 achievements and improved the performance (You guys should be able to get higher render resolutions...hopefully:))

The global achievement statistics are misleading btw. This is due to the fact that achievements have been added several weeks after the release of this game;)

Felix

notes.title: English Audio NOW AVAILABLE! :) + Full Controller Support And "Zero Gravity DLC" Coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

English audio is now available =)

To all the people who helped localizing VR Flush by auditioning for one of the three characters:
Your names are in the game! (You'll just have to find them;))

In other news, VR Flush will be getting full controller support within the next month! Yes, you`ll finally see your hands x)
I am done explaining to people how VR Flush was made before motion controllers where a thing, no more excuses..

Im am also working on a "Zero Gravity (Support The Devs)" DLC which will cost 2€.
It's gonna add zero gravity to the spaceship and - if you choose to - also to the toilet room.
And it will alter the tests you have to complete on the spaceship. (I am going for harder an more creative)
In any case, this DLC is meant to be a fun way to support us if you liked VR Flush:) 



As always PLEASE WRITE REVIEWS and let me know if you have any issues. 

I know that the game looks a bit blurry when played on the HTC Vive (Not the case with Oculus Rift as far as I know). I dont know why though. I'll fix it if I find out why.

Felix =)

You can also follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/WaitForItFelix] Twitter	[/url]  for updates:)

notes.title: English audio will be available soon! + Please write a review:)
notes.content:
As you may have already read in the game description: While VR Flush does have an english interface, it's voice acting is in german only.
This is about to change!

About two weeks ago, I started a casting on two different sites that has already attracted over 65(!) auditions. (Really didn't anticipate that many!:))

I will implement english audio within the next two weeks:)
Thank you for your patience.


Also, let me know if you have any major problems!

If you do understand german:
No matter if you like this game (or hate it), please write a review.
I would love to hear what you think:)

iNvi =)

You can also follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/WaitForItFelix] Twitter	[/url]  for updates:)
